$comment: Ceilings for every shipped wasm artifact, read by `cargo xtask size` against the cargo artifact `cargo xtask dist wasm` ships (the release build with remapped paths, before wasm-bindgen and wasm-opt). Shrink-only: a ceiling more than the headroom above its artifact fails until lowered with `cargo xtask size --update`; raising one is a hand edit, and its reason says why the growth is worth it.

whiteboard-wasm.reason: abi_version(), the batched det exports, and edge_route_on_grid, the routing spike's port of grid-route.ts (ADR-0054 step 5): 92124 bytes measured. The grid router is the subject of the layer-1 harness, whose existing edge suites and routing scoreboards judge it; the per-edge export is a measuring scaffold the spike's own result says to replace with one call per layout, which is when this ceiling is re-measured
